verdict.rationale: BVNK documents onboarding customers through your own platform via its API. Customer verification statuses (INFO_REQUIRED, PENDING, VERIFIED, REJECTED) are pushed by webhook, so a programmatic flow can gate money movement on verification. A Travel Rule webhook also requests counterparty information for crypto payments. However, the pack never names the KYC/KYB submission endpoints or their fields, and documents no recipient or beneficiary verification flow. missing for 10: explicit documented KYC/KYB endpoints and data requirements, recipient/beneficiary verification before payouts, an explicit link between verification status and enabling send/receive, independent or hands-on corroboration.
